verdict.rationale: Bento lets users define failure-mode signals and alert rules in plain English, which compile to trace queries. Its Agent Skills plug into Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to drive integration and migrations from natural-language prompts. Beyond signal and alert authoring and agent-led setup, though, there is no evidence of a general natural-language interface for operating the product, such as triaging issues or querying runs conversationally. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language interface for day-to-day operation (querying runs and analytics, triage), evidence that agents can drive the CLI or dashboard actions from natural language, and independent hands-on corroboration.
